Les jours écrits sont marqués, de la cou: The written days are marked, with the color of your mood.
Un journal intime, une page par jour enr: A personal diary, one page per day saved as you write, with your mood from 1 to 5. A calendar shows written days in the colour of your mood; click a day to read or add to its page. Days written this month, total and streak of days in a row; everything stays in NeoDex and your sync. The journal follows the screen size: the page fills the height, the calendar and its days grow on a large screen, and everything stacks in one column in a narrow window.
